use_jit_decorator: use the jit decorator to wrap a function for optional Parrots JIT compilation
use_jit_decorator_with_params: use the jit decorator with full_shape and optimize parameters to wrap a function
use_skip_no_elena_decorator: use the skip_no_elena decorator to conditionally skip tests when Elena hardware is unavailable
check_parrots_jit_option: check the PARROTS_JIT_OPTION environment variable to see if JIT compilation is enabled
import_jit_from_parrots_jit: import the jit decorator from parrots_jit module for use as a pass-through or Parrots compiler
